{"metadata":{"description":"Wait a minute","id":"gh:1325055896","install_available":false,"language":"HTML","name":"WAM-Framework","slug":"zbbsdsb/WAM-Framework","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# WAM — Wait a Minute"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"An agent framework built on a single conviction: **before answering, understand the situation.**"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## Why "Wait a Minute""},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The name is not about rate-limiting an AI's responses. It is an existential posture."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"When faced with a genuinely daunting task, WAM does not rush to produce a plausible-sounding answer."},{"id":"p5s2","text":" It stops — and works through the problem together with you, one step at a time. This is not caution"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" for its own sake; it is respect for complexity."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The Problem"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Today's agent frameworks reduce collaboration to an endless one-question-one-answer loop. They answe"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"r *within* the conversation, but never *beyond* it. This leaves four structural gaps:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Constructiveness** — Responses react to the latest message; they do not build toward a goal. Th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e agent responds; it does not construct.
2. **Continuity** — Every conversation starts from zero. Th"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e moment a rhythm is broken, complex projects collapse. Humans re-align through communication; agent"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s simply lose the thread.
3. **Verifiability** — Output sounds reasonable but does not hold up under"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" scrutiny. Even a task as basic as "check the paper" cannot be trusted, let alone the work of turnin"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"g unknown-unknowns into known-unknowns during complex design.
4. **Weight judgment** — The agent can"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"not tell what matters. In a complex project, some work is on the critical path, some is nice-to-have"},{"id":"p8s8","text":", some is noise — yet the framework offers no tool for judging importance, so the agent treats every"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"thing as equally important and grasps at everything."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Beneath all four lies a deeper failure: **state desync**. The human carries context, intent, and the"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" weight of every decision; the AI carries none of it. In human teams, misalignment is repaired by ta"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lking it out. In AI collaboration, a single interruption is enough to invalidate the rest of the pro"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" it out. In AI collaboration, a single interruption is enough to invalidate the rest of the project."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This is not a prompt-engineering problem. It is a structural defect of the framework."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## The Philosophy"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### The 1% Foundation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"We are not building a 100% shell — one of those all-capable frameworks that does nothing deeply. WAM"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" builds only the bottom 1% of the foundation, and builds it solidly. That foundation is not a featur"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"e list; it is a fundamental answer to how an agent collaborates with a human: how state stays synchr"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"onized, how goals are constructed, how progress survives, how uncertainty is managed."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### The Sage and the Doer"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"WAM's architecture vision is a **sage** with the hands of a **doer**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- The **sage** sees the whole situation, not the current sentence. It traverses possibilities instea"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"d of taking preset shortcuts. It knows when to be fast and when to be slow. It senses the boundary b"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"etween what we know and what we don't. It is sensitive to weight.
- The **doer** takes only verifiab"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"le steps. It is pragmatic: push forward when possible, admit when not — no bluffing, no forcing. It "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"focuses on the most important 1% and leaves continuable progress behind, never an empty promise."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Whether the underlying system is one agent or many is an implementation detail. However many agents "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"run beneath, the user should face a single, unified, constructive collaborator."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Principles"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Slow down to speed up.** Establish the state before taking the next step.
- **No bluffing.** Fac"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e real difficulty by acknowledging it — then work through it together.
- **A directional 1%.** Every"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" step moves toward the goal, however small.
- **Weight-sensitive.** Hold the critical path; ignore t"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"he noise.
- **Honest.** If it works, push. If it doesn't, say so. Honesty beats polish.
- **Stay in "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"sync.** Keeping the agent and the human aligned — to the extent that communication allows — is the f"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ramework's core duty."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Status"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**M0 — Foundation.** A shared state model and collaboration protocol.
